title: Failing store tests hang node --test; --test-force-exit breaks resident tests on Windows
body:
Close stores in t.after so a failing assertion cannot leave a SQLite handle open, and run a single file with a tool timeout. Use --test-force-exit only for files that start no resident or UI server: on Windows it crashes tests/hooks/resident.test.js. Standalone scripts that open a store must end with process.exit.

Why: A failing assertion before store.close() kept tests/mcp/tools.test.js alive past the 120 s timeout with no output (2026-09-22); --test-force-exit revealed it, but the same flag crashed the resident tests on Windows, so it is not a safe default.

evidence.summary: Item 9 records that --test-force-exit crashes the resident tests on Windows.
Resident tests start UI servers and close them in t.after.
Anchored delivery: keywords validated against this memory's own text and a generic-request corpus before proposing.

v1.trigger: when a single DD test file run with node --test never finishes, or when choosing flags to run test files
